svg.title: Andrés Zapata, integration route
svg.desc: Andrés Zapata, software architect, 10+ years: fintech, banking, logistics and transportation, integrations. Drawn as an Enterprise Integration Patterns route: your problem enters an inbound channel, a content-based router sends it to architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP, DDD, events), integration (EIP, Camel, Quarkus, Kafka) or AI-native delivery (harness, MCP, skills, agents), an aggregator joins the branches and the result goes to production. Leadership and AI trainings run as the control bus.
